mapper.select: SELECT pending.id FROM afv_generation_content_review pending WHERE pending.state = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_generation_content_review running WHERE running.state = 'RUNNING' AND running.model_id = pending.model_id) ORDER BY pending.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_generation_content_review SET state = 'RUNNING', deadline_at = TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 5, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE afv_generation_content_review SET state = 'FAILED', error_message = '审查超时或执行中断，生成结果仍可使用' WHERE state = 'RUNNING' AND deadline_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) LIMIT 32
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_generation_content_review WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
